product_constraint: 50-200% same-request committed Decode uplift, maxima2/3, exact output/state and joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total
mechanism: Confidence-gated verification frontier: evaluate unchanged fixed0.4 softmax confidence at every produced proposal including the configured maximum. Exclude the low-confidence trigger itself from target verification, rather than merely stopping later draft work. Actual submitted count can be0; keep first seed KV if produced, independently of submission count.
equivalence: Any prefix of speculative proposals, including empty, is valid under greedy target verification: verify [seed,submitted proposals], select exact full state before each observer. Discarded proposal is never an accepted/output token. No target/draft arithmetic or numerical contract changes.
work_accounting: Separate physically drafted tokens, submitted proposals, pruned tokens, actual verified rows and histogram; ordered draft hits follow physical drafting, verified=proposed+rounds. All draft/confidence cost remains in Decode.
reference_boundary: Extends the already studied Hugging Face confidence lookahead mechanism; source strategy includes its trigger. Native frontier exclusion is a new hypothesis, not an upstream speed claim or threshold scan.
resources: No new arena or allocation; existing fixed snapshots and dead draft scratch; maxima2/3 reserve unchanged.
validation: host empty/bounded count and prefix-state tests
P65 complete state/logits and dynamic cancellation/failure transactions
immediate d2 P65/8K/40K real API, useful long direction unlocks d3
stop: One composition plus at most one correctness repair; >3% Decode slowdown at any bucket or nonpositive8K stops. No threshold/length/launch sweep. Remove negative composition; production unchanged.
